title: Collecting Rock Salt
description: Ms. Dee needs help collecting 10 rock salts. She can't climb the rocky terrain herself, but needs them to create salty mackerel bait for her husband.
fishingTip: Rock salt can be found by breaking rocks in rocky terrain areas.

objectives.description: Collect 10 rock salts for Ms. Dee

rewards.description: Thanks for your help! Come back anytime with some Mackerel and salt and I'll cook you some of my famous salty bait!
